name: 33860 · Mulberry, FL
findings: ZIP 33860 (Mulberry) has 39 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33860 (Mulberry) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
